decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of the original decision dated 12 September 2025 (Original permission ref: 2025/00506/FUL).

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

394-12 A
394-08 B
394-10 C
394-07 C
394-09
394-11 C

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment: FLOOD RISK ASSESSMENT, MITIGATION, SUSTAINABILITY AND WATER EFFICIENCY. 

No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter.

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - Full details, including physical samples, of all the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before any work commences on site. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - Prior to the commencement of construction, details of the proposed all new and replacement windows and glazing shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The required details shall include a 1:20 scale elevation drawing of each window type showing the glazing pattern and 1:5 scale vertical and horizontal cross section drawings showing the upper and lower stiles, the meeting rails, the dimensions of the glazing, the profile and dimensions of the glazing bars and spacers (if any).  A 1:5 elevation drawing should be provided of any window details, particularly window horns (if any).   The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - Prior to the commencement of construction, details of the proposed all new and replacement roof windows and rooflights shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The required details shall include a manufacturer's specification and illustration, together with a 1:20 scale elevation drawing showing the glazing pattern and 1:5 scale vertical and horizontal cross section drawings showing the location of the rooflight in relation to the roof structure and covering, the frames, the dimensions of the glazing, the profile and dimensions of the glazing bars and spacers (if any).  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 8 - All existing historic features including, but not limited to, chimney pieces, plasterwork, architraves, panelling, doors, staircase balustrading shall remain undisturbed in their existing position and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site, unless specifically authorised otherwise on the drawings hereby approved.  The development and works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 9 - No soil stacks, soil vent pipes, plumbing, pipes, flues, vents or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building other than those shown on the drawings hereby approved.

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 10 - Details of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works.  The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved:
a.)	A detailed method statement and schedule of works including the proposed demolition, construction, and how the existing historic fabric will be protected during the works. 

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 11 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the new flank elevations windows as shown on drawing: 394-11 C shall be fitted with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and shall be non-opening and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level. The window shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved. 

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
description:
Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of the planning permission reference:
2025/00506/FUL dated 12th September 2025 for the "Erection of a rear extension at first floor
level on top of the existing back addition, and installation of a window to the side elevation at
first floor level to nos.58 and 60; demolition of existing conservatory and erection of a
replacement single storey lean-to rear extension to the side of existing back addition to no.60;
associated alterations." Amendment sought to extend the proposed single storey lean-to rear
extension to the side of existing back addition to no.60.
